scope: Specification/file consistency only. Not code execution on the target server, not new model inference or benchmark verification.
source_review: Connected GitHub excerpts and pinned source records; an optional local mirror failed DNS and is not claimed.

checks.detail: Full pinned SHAs appear in the execution directive.
Five controls plus eight variants; no duplicated method IDs.
Every machine method has an English operational definition.
10 scenes x 13 methods = 130 prediction records.
Two rankings = 260 records; not image runs.
13 methods x two rank views = 26 pooled Replica records.
5 policy/seed paths x 10 scenes x B200.
8 Replica x two policies x (B100+B400).
Calibration and Replica names disjoint; exposure status explicit.
Old confirmation explicitly excluded; selection cannot use fresh results.
Bounded, source-balanced objective; shared support and fallback specified.
No silent N0 vote when N0 is deleted from fusion.
Representation change and matched calibration separately defined.
Probability metrics include fixed population and formulas.
Ranking/aggregation views are distinct and do not relax source invariants.
Current-frame replay, quota and state rules are explicit.
Text-only stress cannot alter query trajectories or discard distractor errors.
Cached ablations do not authorize new model training or image inference.
All declared phases have a written execution requirement.
22 source IDs resolve to pinned repository paths.
Only supplied blob identities are recorded; no invented SHA256 mirroring claim.
Proposed code is not described as existing.
Code, results and three reports must be committed and remote-verified.
Focused tests only; no old publication rehash requirement.

manual_review_corrections: Added true official dataset-pool evaluation alongside scene means.
Kept official reranking in evaluation-only manifests instead of relaxing S/Q locks.
Split N0 representation probe into fixed-temperature and N0-only refit rows.
Prevented absent N0 from returning through the A3 fallback.
Used shared-temperature objective matched to per-source NLL, not mixture-NLL.
Required random B200 replay to use a new study contract rather than old exploration aliases.
Fixed vocabulary tests to original query trajectories and actual stored aggregates.
Excluded old confirmation scenes from new freshness claims.
Isolated fresh-stage data availability from mandatory cached and query experiments.
remaining_execution_dependencies: Target-server source arrays and cached features must be readable.
Replacement query requests may require bounded native inference.
Fresh four-scene check may be unavailable; core work must still complete.
GitHub push uses existing authentication and is not performed by this package.
